priorities.item: Commercial admission and complete cost coverage
priorities.scope: Audit #468 separately; require funded customer/company/provider reservations and non-usage cost coverage.
priorities.acceptance: Maximum simultaneous entitlements, no creator sales, annual billing, refunds/disputes and one-customer fixed costs are covered; unknown tax/cost inputs keep paid opening closed.

priorities.item: Edit funnel steps directly from the journey
priorities.scope: Reuse existing page editors and already-loaded page/product identities.
priorities.acceptance: One navigation from a saved step to the correct store and editor; hide removed/unauthorized targets; disable prefetch and preserve save recovery.

priorities.scope: Integrate existing pages, forms, products, bumps, offers and consented follow-up drafts.
priorities.acceptance: Every warning links to its real editor; no unapproved publication/send/payment; partial failures remain recoverable.

priorities.item: Migration dry run and repair report
priorities.scope: Extend existing bounded imports with a versioned ClickFunnels adapter.
priorities.acceptance: Preview every row/resource, duplicates, consent and unsupported scripts; repeat-safe bounded application; no copied vendor assets.

priorities.scope: Reuse campaign tags and Stripe events; declare attribution and money definitions.
priorities.acceptance: Orders/refunds/disputes/renewals reconcile by currency; unknown attribution visible; no claim that attribution proves causal lift.

priorities.scope: Audit existing two-tier book, coupons, hub and creator-owned PayPal batches.
priorities.acceptance: No duplicate payout after a lost response; refund/dispute correction and reserve policy tested; no live transfer in development.

priorities.scope: Review existing revenue-based headline tests instead of adding another test engine.
priorities.acceptance: Predeclared measure, repeated-look policy, allocation checks, refund maturity and insufficient-data state.

priorities.scope: Use shared content/network/device fixtures and real navigation traces.
priorities.acceptance: Desktop/mobile task completion and latency percentiles recorded; publish fewer-clicks/faster claims only after comparable measurements.

priorities.scope: Original structured pages and follow-up drafts from owned product facts.
priorities.acceptance: Funded maximum request cost reserved before every call; bounded input/output/tools/retries; schema validation and human review; no invented proof or autonomous publication.

priorities.scope: Deterministic readiness checks first; model explanations only after budget approval.
priorities.acceptance: Each recommendation cites its actual page/data, has a reversible action and handles insufficient evidence.

priorities.scope: Integrate approved prices, currencies and tax readiness.
